title: AgentRunLog
description: Records the outcome of a single chronological execution cycle of the BibleFi agentic scripture-pipeline. One AgentRunLog is created by the master agent at the start of every hourly run and updated as subagents complete their tasks.

run_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this execution run (UUID v4).

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the AgentRunLog schema (e.g. '1.0.0').

triggered_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the master agent was triggered.

trigger_type.description: 'scheduled' = invoked by the hourly cron; 'manual' = triggered by an operator; 'event' = triggered by an on-chain or dApp event.

status.description: Overall status of this execution cycle. 'partial' indicates that some subagent tasks succeeded while others failed.

master_agent_id.description: Identifier of the master agent instance that orchestrated this run.

master_sandbox_id.description: Sandbox environment ID used by the master agent for this run.

pipeline_stages.description: Ordered list of pipeline stages executed during this run, each corresponding to an agent type.

task_ids.description: UUIDs of AgentTask records belonging to this stage.

started_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this stage began.

completed_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this stage finished.

verses_scanned.description: Total Bible verses examined by scripture_search agents during this run.

scriptures_found.description: Number of financially-themed scriptures identified before validation.

scriptures_language_validated.description: Number of scriptures that passed cross-language validation (Hebrew, Greek, Aramaic).

scriptures_theologically_validated.description: Number of scriptures that passed theological validation via concordances and dictionaries.

scriptures_seeded.description: Number of validated scripture records pushed to the BibleFi dApp this cycle.

tasks_total.description: Total number of AgentTask records spawned during this run.

tasks_completed.description: Number of tasks that reached 'completed' status.

tasks_failed.description: Number of tasks that reached 'failed' status.

duration_seconds.description: Total wall-clock time in seconds from triggered_at to completed_at.

seed_batch_id.description: UUID of the ScriptureSeedBatch record produced by the dApp seeder stage of this run, if applicable.

error_summary.description: High-level description of any errors that prevented the run from completing successfully.

completed_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the run reached a terminal status.

next_scheduled_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the next planned run, typically one hour after triggered_at.

tags.description: Optional free-form tags for observability and filtering.
